name: enum-extension-index-long-form-accepted
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): Input writes the extension index 1 of w in the long form of a normally small number (1, length 1, 01) where the short form fits; decode accepts it (ruling 7), giving 4, and encode writes the short form 0 000001. 132 bits, padded with 4 zero bits to 17 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
